title: Rule evaluation request (schemaVersion 1.0.0)
description: Complete input to one interpreter evaluation. Interpreters are pure: every value that can affect the outcome appears here, so the same request always yields the same Decision in Python and TypeScript. The request carries no wall-clock dependency of its own.

ruleVersion.description: Rule version pinned to the incident. A value other than the loaded package version fails with rule_mismatch.

clinicalState.description: Current clinical state id. Kept separate from interactionMode, connection state, and incident status.

expectedStateRevision.description: When present and different from stateRevision, evaluation fails with stale_revision instead of producing a decision.

expectedModeRevision.description: When present and different from modeRevision, evaluation fails with stale_revision. Queued output from an earlier mode revision must never be applied.

type.description: observation evaluates transitions; timer reacts to an elapsed declared timer; mode_change applies the new mode policy without advancing clinical state; resume restores timers after a page or mode interruption without replaying missed reminders.

timerId.description: Required when type is timer, forbidden otherwise.

previousInteractionMode.description: Optional provenance for mode_change and resume triggers. Recorded in the decision; it does not change evaluation.

timers.description: Current state of declared timers as known by the caller.
